## __MAIN STORY PART 2 CHAPTER 1 RELEASE__
Thank you for playing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.

Main Story Part 2 Chapter 1 "A New Threat" is now available as of <t:1788231600>.

Head to Home > Story > Main Story Part 2 and select Chapter 1 to experience it.
While you can play the content even if you have not cleared the previous Main Story Part 1 chapters, we recommend clearing up to Part 1 Chapter 14 first.

In addition, you can obtain a special Home background upon clearing Main Story Part 2 Chapter 1.

## __NEW CHAPTER EVENT__
To celebrate the release of Main Story Part 2 Chapter 1, the New Chapter Event is now available.
Take part in the event from Home > Events > New Chapter Event after clearing Main Story Chapter 0.

### __EVENT OVERVIEW__
Progress through Main Story Part 2 Chapter 1 and challenge the score battles to earn rewards such as Dimensional Crystals.

■ Score Battle
During the event, you can challenge score battles of varying difficulties.
These battles do not consume Stamina and are unlocked by progressing through the new Main Story chapter.

Please check the event screen for the specific unlock conditions for each difficulty.

For the score battles in this event, your performance is evaluated and scored based on the following three criteria:
・Number of rounds elapsed at victory
・Remaining HP at victory
・Max DMG in a single attack (HARD/VERY HARD)

Scores are ranked from C, B, A, to S. (No score will be awarded for a defeat.)
Your current highest score can be viewed on the event screen. For reference on further increasing your scores, please check the breakdown for each criterion on the Result screen.

There are two types of rewards related to score battles: first-clear rewards and mission rewards, which are earned by achieving a certain score.

■ Stage Effects
The New Chapter Event features unique stage effects.
Utilize the stage effects and push for the highest score.

■ Missions
You can earn rewards and titles by clearing various missions.

## __MAIN STORY PART 2 CHAPTER 1 RELEASE CELEBRATION LOGIN BONUS__
Log in during the period to get up to 10 Pickup Gacha Tickets.
In addition, you can get valuable items such as THE GAME Gacha Tickets and Stamina Jellies.

## __IMPORTANT__
The schedule for this event is subject to change without prior notice. We appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for your continued support of KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.

## __DETAILS__

### __THE DEFENSE FORCE PASS__
- During the period, you can raise your Pass Level by completing missions and accumulating points.
- At each Pass Level, you can claim rewards such as Gacha Tickets and enhancement materials.
- The Defense Force Pass changes periodically, and when a new one begins, the missions and your Pass Level will be reset.

### __POINTS__
- There is a limit to the points that can be earned each week.
- Aside from clearing missions, you can also earn points by spending Dimensional Crystals. These points do not count toward the weekly limit.
For more details, please check the Defense Force Pass > the "i" button.

### __DEFENSE FORCE PASS TYPES__
There are three types of Defense Force Passes.

`━ ROW 1 OF 3:`
> `❚ 1:` Free Pass
> `❚ 2:` This pass is unlocked by default.

`━ ROW 2 OF 3:`
> `❚ 1:` Premium Pass
> `❚ 2:` Purchasing this pass instantly grants you Dimensional Crystal x680. The number of items you can obtain when your Pass Level goes up will also increase.

`━ ROW 3 OF 3:`
> `❚ 1:` Deluxe Pass
> `❚ 2:` This is an upgrade to the Premium Pass.
> `❚ └─` Purchasing this pass instantly grants you Dimensional Crystal x1,080, Weapon Supply Box IV x1, Kaiju Core Material x1, and Stamina Jelly x5. It also instantly boosts your Pass Level by 10.
*The Premium Pass and Deluxe Pass are only valid for the ongoing Defense Force Pass at the time of purchase.*

*The Deluxe Pass is a set that includes the Premium Pass, along with the Dimensional Crystal x1,080, Weapon Supply Box IV, etc. that can be received instantly upon purchase. If you purchase the Deluxe Pass first, it counts as also having purchased the Premium Pass. If you purchase the Premium Pass first, you can then purchase the Deluxe Pass at a reduced price. In this case, please note that the number of Dimensional Crystals you instantly receive upon purchasing the Deluxe Pass will be the difference of 400.*
*The select ★5 weapon can only be obtained from the Weapon Supply Box IV obtained through the Defense Force Pass.*

*You will also be able to get the Weapon Supply Box IV from the next Defense Force Pass.*
*Even if you have reached the weekly point limit, purchasing the Deluxe Pass will still instantly increase your Pass Level.*

## __IMPORTANT__
- Due to the nature of the product, returns and exchanges are not accepted.
- The availability period and content are subject to change without prior notice. We appreciate your understanding.
- Premium Pass and Deluxe Pass purchases close 1 hour before Defense Force Pass ends.
- Unclaimed rewards when the period ends will be delivered to Mail (Home screen > Mail). Please also note that unclaimed rewards will be removed when they expire.
- Defense Force Pass rewards can be claimed on a different device that is linked to the same account.
- If player data has been deleted, Defense Force Pass rewards cannot be claimed even if a new account has been created on the same device.

1003540.article_name: DIMENSIONAL SWARM DISASTER SEASON 1 NOW AVAILABLE!
article_raws: ⤷Overview⤷Dimensional Swarm Disaster has come online as of 2026-08-31T08:00:00Z.⤷Dimensional Swarm Disaster is a high-difficulty, seasonal battle event where you can gather Support Effects to power up your squad.⤷Equip desirable effects to gain an advantage in the battles and earn rewards upon clearing missions!⤷⤷
Eligibility⤷Reach Spec-Ops Rank 4 or higher⤷⤷

Event Description⤷In Dimensional Swarm Disaster, gather Support Effects to power up your squad as you progress through the battle content.⤷Gather Support Effects from Patrol Quests and proceed with Area Unlock quests to unlock higher Threat Levels.⤷As you progress through the event, a trading function will unlock, allowing you to list and purchase items (such as Support Effects) with other players. Make use of this function to effectively collect desirable Support Effects.⤷Gather desirable Support Effects from Patrol Quests of higher Threat Levels and take on the powerful enemy in Challenge Mode.⤷⤷

*Dimensional Swarm Disaster is a seasonal event. Except for the Shop item "Dimensional Medals" obtained from mission rewards, all items will be removed when the event ends and cannot be used in the next Dimensional Swarm Disaster.⤷⤷

PATROL QUESTS Patrol Quests consist of random combinations of Kaiju and Kaiju buffs.⤷When clearing Patrol Quests, Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items will randomly drop.⤷Threat Levels will affect the difficulty of Patrol Quests. Kaiju in higher Threat Level quests are stronger; however, clearing these quests allows you to obtain better items.⤷Patrol Quest Threat Levels will increase as you clear Area Unlock quests, up to a maximum of Threat Level 10.⤷While taking on Kaiju, if you find it to be too challenging, you can change the Threat Level of Patrol Quests by using the Edit Lv button.⤷

You can skip up to 10 Patrol Quests per day. Once you have cleared a Patrol Quest, skipping quests of the same Threat Level becomes available.⤷Patrol Quests are assigned random quest types. Depending on the type, there will be chances to get better item drops.⤷After challenging 3 Patrol Quests on the map, you can rescan currently displayed quests.⤷Clear the quests effectively and gather Support Effects to take on the Area Unlock quests.⤷⤷*You cannot challenge a Patrol Quest you have already attempted. Challenge at least 3 quests to perform a rescan.⤷

⤷AREA UNLOCK QUESTS Area Unlock quests consist of fixed combinations of Kaiju and Kaiju buffs.⤷There are 9 Threat Levels in total. Clearing higher Threat Levels in Area Unlock quests will unlock new Threat Levels for Patrol Quests.⤷Random Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items will drop only upon first clear.⤷You will face powerful Kaiju while taking on Area Unlock quests. Be sure to fully prepare yourself by equipping useful Support Effects obtained via Patrol Quests.⤷

⤷CHALLENGE MODE Take on Kaiju with massive HP and compete for a top ranking.⤷Challenge Mode is unlocked after clearing Area Unlock: Threat Level 3.⤷Extremely powerful Kaiju will appear, so unlock new Threat Levels through Area Unlock quests and Patrol Quests to gather desirable Support Effect combinations and compete for a top ranking.⤷⤷
Support Effects⤷

SUPPORT EFFECTS Support Effects are items obtainable from Patrol Quests and Area Unlock quests.⤷Support Effects consist of 1 Main Effect and 4 Sub Effects. Equip them to power up your squad.⤷Equip Support Effects before challenging a quest on the Dimensional Swarm Disaster: Setup screen.⤷⤷*Owned Support Effects will be discarded once the event ends and cannot be carried over to the next season.⤷

⤷TYPE/RARITY There are three types of Support Effects: Attack, Defense, and Special. You can equip up to one Support Effect of each type.⤷Support Effects come in 3 rarities: ★3 / ★4 / ★5. Higher rarity yields stronger effects.⤷⤷
MAIN EFFECTS The Main Effect is fixed for each Support Effect.⤷Higher Support Effect rarity offers higher effect values.⤷⤷

SUB EFFECTS When obtaining a Support Effect, 4 Sub Effects are randomly assigned at random values.⤷Sub Effects are assigned differently based on the type of Support Effect.⤷Also, Sub Effects are numbered from 1 to 4, with different effects available for 1-2 and 3-4 separately.⤷Higher Support Effect rarity increases the chance of getting better effects.⤷⤷

MODIFYING SUPPORT EFFECTS Support Effect Mod Items allow you to redraw the Sub Effects of Support Effects.⤷Sub Effects 1-4 can be redrawn depending on the type of Mod Item.⤷Higher Mod Item rarity increases the chance of granting better values.⤷Modifying is unlocked after clearing the quest Area Unlock: Threat Level 1.⤷⤷
*Owned Mod Items will be discarded once the event ends and cannot be carried over to the next season.⤷⤷
Trading⤷In Dimensional Swarm Disaster, the selling or purchasing of Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items between players will be available using Tokens.⤷⤷

TOKENS Tokens are exclusive items used to trade with other players.⤷Obtained Support Effects can be exchanged for Tokens via Quick Sell.⤷Quick Sell can be performed on the Support Effects/Items screen under the Owned tab.⤷Tokens acquired via Quick Sell vary according to the type and rarity of Support Effects sold.⤷⤷

*A maximum of 999,999,999 Tokens can be held. Tokens exceeding the limit will be discarded when acquired.⤷*Acquired Tokens will be discarded once the event ends and cannot be carried over to the next season.⤷*When the max Support Effect limit is reached, you cannot deploy for or skip quests. Please sell the unneeded Support Effects.⤷*Quick Sell is not available for Support Effect Mod Items.⤷⤷

LISTING You can set your own prices and list owned Support Effects/Support Effect Mod Items for other players.⤷When other players purchase your listed items, you will earn Tokens equal to the set price.⤷Quick Sell Support Effects to acquire Tokens.⤷There is a limit to the number of Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items you can list respectively.⤷If you reach the limit, withdrawing listed items will allow you to list other items.⤷
You can list items after clearing the quest Area Unlock: Threat Level 3.⤷⤷

PURCHASING Support Effects and Mod Items listed by other players can be purchased using acquired Tokens.⤷Purchase Support Effects at the price set by other players, provided you have enough Tokens.⤷When purchasing Mod Items, specify your desired price per unit and purchase quantity to buy items at the quantity that meets your criteria.⤷You can purchase items after clearing the quest Area Unlock: Threat Level 3.⤷⤷
Rewards⤷

MISSION REWARDS There are missions in Dimensional Swarm Disaster.⤷Obtain Dimensional Medals from the missions.⤷You can exchange Dimensional Medals for various items in the Shop.⤷Shop items that are not labelled with "Days left:" remain exchangeable using Dimensional Medals obtained from the next season of Dimensional Swarm Disaster.⤷Owned Dimensional Medals will be carried over even after the event ends.⤷

⤷CHALLENGE MODE REWARDS Challenge Mode features damage-based ranking. You can earn rewards according to your rank.⤷The total damage dealt in a battle serves as your score. Rankings will be determined based on the highest scores during the period.⤷You can check your score and rank from Challenge Mode > Ranking.¹⤷Ranking rewards will be distributed via Mail after the tallying period following the event's conclusion.²⤷

For details on rewards, please refer to Challenge Mode > Ranking > Rewards.⤷⤷¹ The Top 100 info on the Ranking screen is updated every 5 minutes. Depending on the timing of the update, your score may differ from the score displayed in the rankings.⤷² The mail (including any attached items) will be deleted 90 days after you receive it. Please make sure to open the mail and claim the items before the deadline.⤷⤷

Event Progress Reset⤷Obtained Support Effects, Support Effect Mod Items, Tokens and all quest progress will be reset once the event ends. They will not be carried over to the next season.⤷Acquired Dimensional Medals will be retained and the number owned will not be reset.⤷⤷
Important⤷Once the claim period ends, Mission rewards will no longer be available (and will not be sent to your Mail). Please remember to claim them within the event period.⤷
article_item:
## __OVERVIEW__
Dimensional Swarm Disaster has come online as of <t:1788163200>.
Dimensional Swarm Disaster is a high-difficulty, seasonal battle event where you can gather Support Effects to power up your squad.
Equip desirable effects to gain an advantage in the battles and earn rewards upon clearing missions!

## __ELIGIBILITY__
Reach Spec-Ops Rank 4 or higher

## __EVENT DESCRIPTION__
- In Dimensional Swarm Disaster, gather Support Effects to power up your squad as you progress through the battle content.
- Gather Support Effects from Patrol Quests and proceed with Area Unlock quests to unlock higher Threat Levels.
- As you progress through the event, a trading function will unlock, allowing you to list and purchase items (such as Support Effects) with other players. Make use of this function to effectively collect desirable Support Effects.
- Gather desirable Support Effects from Patrol Quests of higher Threat Levels and take on the powerful enemy in Challenge Mode.

*Dimensional Swarm Disaster is a seasonal event. Except for the Shop item "Dimensional Medals" obtained from mission rewards, all items will be removed when the event ends and cannot be used in the next Dimensional Swarm Disaster.*

### __PATROL QUESTS__
- Patrol Quests consist of random combinations of Kaiju and Kaiju buffs.
- When clearing Patrol Quests, Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items will randomly drop.
- Threat Levels will affect the difficulty of Patrol Quests. Kaiju in higher Threat Level quests are stronger; however, clearing these quests allows you to obtain better items.
- Patrol Quest Threat Levels will increase as you clear Area Unlock quests, up to a maximum of Threat Level 10.
- While taking on Kaiju, if you find it to be too challenging, you can change the Threat Level of Patrol Quests by using the Edit Lv button.

- You can skip up to 10 Patrol Quests per day. Once you have cleared a Patrol Quest, skipping quests of the same Threat Level becomes available.
- Patrol Quests are assigned random quest types. Depending on the type, there will be chances to get better item drops.
- After challenging 3 Patrol Quests on the map, you can rescan currently displayed quests.
- Clear the quests effectively and gather Support Effects to take on the Area Unlock quests.

*You cannot challenge a Patrol Quest you have already attempted. Challenge at least 3 quests to perform a rescan.*

### __AREA UNLOCK QUESTS__
- Area Unlock quests consist of fixed combinations of Kaiju and Kaiju buffs.
- There are 9 Threat Levels in total. Clearing higher Threat Levels in Area Unlock quests will unlock new Threat Levels for Patrol Quests.
- Random Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items will drop only upon first clear.
- You will face powerful Kaiju while taking on Area Unlock quests. Be sure to fully prepare yourself by equipping useful Support Effects obtained via Patrol Quests.

### __CHALLENGE MODE__
- Take on Kaiju with massive HP and compete for a top ranking.
- Challenge Mode is unlocked after clearing Area Unlock: Threat Level 3.
- Extremely powerful Kaiju will appear, so unlock new Threat Levels through Area Unlock quests and Patrol Quests to gather desirable Support Effect combinations and compete for a top ranking.
## __SUPPORT EFFECTS__

### __SUPPORT EFFECTS__
- Support Effects are items obtainable from Patrol Quests and Area Unlock quests.
- Support Effects consist of 1 Main Effect and 4 Sub Effects. Equip them to power up your squad.
- Equip Support Effects before challenging a quest on the Dimensional Swarm Disaster: Setup screen.

*Owned Support Effects will be discarded once the event ends and cannot be carried over to the next season.*

### __TYPE/RARITY__
- There are three types of Support Effects: Attack, Defense, and Special. You can equip up to one Support Effect of each type.
- Support Effects come in 3 rarities: ★3 / ★4 / ★5. Higher rarity yields stronger effects.

### __MAIN EFFECTS__
- The Main Effect is fixed for each Support Effect.
- Higher Support Effect rarity offers higher effect values.

### __SUB EFFECTS__
- When obtaining a Support Effect, 4 Sub Effects are randomly assigned at random values.
- Sub Effects are assigned differently based on the type of Support Effect.
- Also, Sub Effects are numbered from 1 to 4, with different effects available for 1-2 and 3-4 separately.
- Higher Support Effect rarity increases the chance of getting better effects.

### __MODIFYING SUPPORT EFFECTS__
- Support Effect Mod Items allow you to redraw the Sub Effects of Support Effects.
- Sub Effects 1-4 can be redrawn depending on the type of Mod Item.
- Higher Mod Item rarity increases the chance of granting better values.
- Modifying is unlocked after clearing the quest Area Unlock: Threat Level 1.
*Owned Mod Items will be discarded once the event ends and cannot be carried over to the next season.*

## __TRADING__
- In Dimensional Swarm Disaster, the selling or purchasing of Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items between players will be available using Tokens.

### __TOKENS__
- Tokens are exclusive items used to trade with other players.
- Obtained Support Effects can be exchanged for Tokens via Quick Sell.
- Quick Sell can be performed on the Support Effects/Items screen under the Owned tab.
- Tokens acquired via Quick Sell vary according to the type and rarity of Support Effects sold.

*A maximum of 999,999,999 Tokens can be held. Tokens exceeding the limit will be discarded when acquired.*
*Acquired Tokens will be discarded once the event ends and cannot be carried over to the next season.*
*When the max Support Effect limit is reached, you cannot deploy for or skip quests. Please sell the unneeded Support Effects.*
*Quick Sell is not available for Support Effect Mod Items.*

### __LISTING__
- You can set your own prices and list owned Support Effects/Support Effect Mod Items for other players.
- When other players purchase your listed items, you will earn Tokens equal to the set price.
- Quick Sell Support Effects to acquire Tokens.
- There is a limit to the number of Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items you can list respectively.
- If you reach the limit, withdrawing listed items will allow you to list other items.
- You can list items after clearing the quest Area Unlock: Threat Level 3.

### __PURCHASING__
- Support Effects and Mod Items listed by other players can be purchased using acquired Tokens.
- Purchase Support Effects at the price set by other players, provided you have enough Tokens.
- When purchasing Mod Items, specify your desired price per unit and purchase quantity to buy items at the quantity that meets your criteria.
- You can purchase items after clearing the quest Area Unlock: Threat Level 3.
## __REWARDS__

### __MISSION REWARDS__
- There are missions in Dimensional Swarm Disaster.
- Obtain Dimensional Medals from the missions.
- You can exchange Dimensional Medals for various items in the Shop.
- Shop items that are not labelled with "Days left:" remain exchangeable using Dimensional Medals obtained from the next season of Dimensional Swarm Disaster.
- Owned Dimensional Medals will be carried over even after the event ends.

### __CHALLENGE MODE REWARDS__
- Challenge Mode features damage-based ranking. You can earn rewards according to your rank.
- The total damage dealt in a battle serves as your score. Rankings will be determined based on the highest scores during the period.
- You can check your score and rank from Challenge Mode > Ranking.¹
- Ranking rewards will be distributed via Mail after the tallying period following the event's conclusion.²

- For details on rewards, please refer to Challenge Mode > Ranking > Rewards.

¹ The Top 100 info on the Ranking screen is updated every 5 minutes. Depending on the timing of the update, your score may differ from the score displayed in the rankings.
² The mail (including any attached items) will be deleted 90 days after you receive it. Please make sure to open the mail and claim the items before the deadline.

## __EVENT PROGRESS RESET__
- Obtained Support Effects, Support Effect Mod Items, Tokens and all quest progress will be reset once the event ends. They will not be carried over to the next season.
- Acquired Dimensional Medals will be retained and the number owned will not be reset.

## __IMPORTANT__
- Once the claim period ends, Mission rewards will no longer be available (and will not be sent to your Mail). Please remember to claim them within the event period.

## __OVERVIEW__
Thank you for playing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.

Maintenance has been completed. The Version 2.1.0 update is now available.
Thank you for your cooperation during the maintenance.

## __UPDATE CONTENT__
■ KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME 1st Anniversary Round 3
For more details, please stay tuned for updates on the official X of KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME ([@kj8_TheGame_EN](https://x.com/Kj8_TheGame_EN)).
What's more, we streamed live on <t:1788087600> to bring you the latest news on KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME. Watch it [here](https://www.youtube.com/live/hdRzTUeuYAM).

■ New Feature: Dimensional Swarm Disaster
Experience brand-new content where you take on swarms of Kaiju more powerful than ever before.
Clear stages, gather Support Effects, equip them, and face the Kaiju.
For more details, please check the relevant announcement.
[・Dimensional Swarm Disaster Season 1 Now Available!](https://info.kj8-thegame.com/news/news/1003540?language=en)

■ Improvement to Story Screen
The Story screen has been updated to support Main Story Part 2.
*Main Story content up to the current point will display as Part 1. Following this change, descriptions for some Achievements and missions related to the Main Story have been adjusted.*

■ Improvement to Fierce Battle Area (Permanent) - High Difficulty
・Challenge restrictions have been lifted. Players can now take on stages directly, even if prior stages have yet to be cleared.

*Following this adjustment, the method for obtaining titles for future Fierce Battle Area (Permanent) High Difficulty stages has been updated.*
・Stage UI has been updated.

■ Other Minor Improvements
・Pressing outside the Confirm Skip screen now closes it.
・The confirmation prompt is now skipped when pressing SKIP in Training: Special Enhancement Material.

・When selecting the maximum quantity of Stamina Jellies on the Stamina recovery screen, you will now only select the amount needed to reach maximum Stamina.

■ New Gacha
The following Gacha is now available:
・[Limited] Akari Minase Pickup Gacha (Rerun)
For more details, please check the relevant announcement.

[・[Limited] Akari Minase Pickup Gacha Rerun Now Available!](https://info.kj8-thegame.com/news/news/1003520?language=en)

■ New Trainings and Limit Unlock Materials
Scheduled to start: <t:1788231600>
New Trainings and limit unlock materials will be added.
For more details, please check the upcoming announcement.

■ Fierce Battle Area (Limited)
Scheduled to start: <t:1788490800>
A new Fierce Battle Area (Limited) will be available.
For more details, please check the upcoming announcement.
・Resolved Issues

The following issues have been resolved:

・Under certain conditions, when using ★5 [The Reigning King of Kaiju] Reno Ichikawa's Combat Skill, the visual effect applied to the target character of Attunement does not display correctly.
*This is only a display issue. It does not affect the actual effects.*

・For Return to Action missions started before <t:1785488400>, rewards cannot be claimed by pressing the "Claim All" button.

*Rewards can still be claimed individually for each mission.*

・Under certain conditions, Transcendence Gauge may not display when fully charged.
*This is only a display issue. Transcendence Arts can still be activated by pressing the corresponding area on the screen.*

・On the Character Skills screen, the help icon for Transcendence Arts does not display.

・Under certain conditions, reaching a new record in Total War does not display "NEW RECORD" on the Result screen.
*This is only a display issue. It does not affect the rewards earned.*

・When activating a Follow-Up Skill or Extra Attack during certain battles, unintended animations may occur.
*This is only a display issue. It does not impact the battle or the actual effects.*

## __IMPORTANT__
- After this maintenance, a download of approximately 4.4 GB for the mobile version, or 7.3 GB for the PC version will be required. A Wi-Fi connection is recommended for download.
*This data update will perform data optimization, including data from previous updates.*
We appreciate your cooperation as we continue to work on improving our services.
Thank you for your continued support of KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.

## __EVENT DESCRIPTION__
- The Mop-Up Operation is a competitive event where all players work to neutralize a massive number of Kaiju.
- The Mop-Up Operation consists of 5 stages, and you can challenge each stage until the remaining number of Kaiju reaches 0.
- Use specific permits to take part in Mop-Up Operation.¹ ²
- Each battle ends once 5 rounds have elapsed. Defeat as many Kaiju as possible within 5 rounds.
- Each of the 5 stages offers different rewards.

- The more Kaiju you defeat in a single battle, the greater the rewards you obtain. Battles will end automatically once you have reached the maximum obtainable rewards.
- In every stage, there is a rare chance to obtain ★5 Unimaterial [Caudata-Type Kaiju α], which guarantees a ★5 Unipart when used during development.
- Skipping is not available for Mop-Up Operation.
- The event ends once the remaining number of Kaiju in all stages reaches 0.

¹ During the availability period of the Mop-Up Operation, up to 5 Mop-Up Operation Permits can be claimed on the event screen every 4:00 AM JST. If you have unused Mop-Up Operation Permits at 4:00 AM JST, you can claim new ones to reach a total of 5.
² Mop-Up Operation Permits can also be replenished up to 5 times per day using Dimensional Crystal x20. The replenish count resets daily at 4:00 AM JST.

## __IMPORTANT__
- If a Mop-Up Operation battle ends in defeat, retreat, or suspension, rewards will still be granted based on the number of Kaiju defeated up until that point. However, Mop-Up Operation Permits will not be refunded.

## __OVERVIEW__
Large Conquest: Concerted Onslaught has come online as of <t:1786849200>.
Large Conquest is a battle event where you fight against continuously appearing Kaiju.
Utilize stage effects, challenge the Kaiju, and clear quests to earn rewards and titles!

The quick clear feature is available for this event.
Stages up to Stage 04 will be unlocked and available as initial stages. By clearing any unlocked stage with ☆3, all its previous stages will also be considered cleared with ☆3.

## __ELIGIBILITY__
Reach Spec-Ops Rank 2 or higher.

## __EVENT DESCRIPTION__
- Large Conquest is a battle event where you fight against continuously appearing Kaiju.
- Access the event from Events > Large Conquest.
- Large Conquest does not require Stamina to challenge.
- Each quest requires you to form 2 squads. Some quests are of higher difficulty.
- A quest is cleared when a set number of rounds have elapsed or a set number of Kaiju have been neutralized.

- By completing ☆ Objectives and clearing quests, you can earn rewards like Dimensional Crystals, Proofs of Valor, Emblems of Defense, etc.
- You can exchange Proofs of Valor and Emblems of Defense for enhancement materials and other items in the Shop.

## __STAGE EFFECTS__
- Large Conquest features unique stage effects.
- Utilize the stage effects to give yourself an advantage in neutralizing Kaiju.

## __TITLES__
- In this Large Conquest, you can obtain separate titles after meeting the following conditions: "Obtain all Clear Rewards" and "Obtain the ☆18 Reward."

## __IMPORTANT__
- Once the event ends, Large Conquest rewards will no longer be available (and will not be sent to your Mail). Please remember to claim them within the event period.

article_item:
## __OVERVIEW__
Fierce Battle Area (Limited): Onslaught of Purple Lightning has come online as of <t:1785898800>.
Unlike Fierce Battle Area (Permanent), Fierce Battle Area (Limited) is a limited-time event that comes with its own unique stage effects.
Also, some quests feature trial guest characters that you can include in your squad.
Utilize stage effects, challenge the Kaiju, and clear quests to earn rewards and titles!

The quick clear feature is available for this event.
Stages up to Stage 06 will be unlocked and available as initial stages. By clearing any unlocked stage with ☆3, all its previous stages will also be considered cleared with ☆3.

## __ELIGIBILITY__
Reach Spec-Ops Rank 2 or higher.

## __EVENT DESCRIPTION__
- Fierce Battle Area (Limited) is a battle event where you can go up against powerful Kaiju.
- Access the event from Events > Fierce Battle Area.
- Fierce Battle Area does not require Stamina to challenge.
- Some quests are of higher difficulty and require you to form 2 squads.
- By completing ⭐︎ Objectives and clearing quests, you can earn rewards like Dimensional Crystals, Proofs of Valor, Emblems of Defense, etc.
- You can exchange Proofs of Valor and Emblems of Defense for enhancement materials and other items in the Shop.

## __STAGE EFFECTS__
- Fierce Battle Area (Limited) features unique stage effects.
- Utilize the stage effects to give yourself an advantage in neutralizing Kaiju.

## __TRIAL CHARACTERS__
- Some Fierce Battle Area (Limited) quests feature trial guest characters that you can include in your squad.

## __TITLES__
- In this Fierce Battle Area, you can obtain separate titles after meeting the following conditions: "Obtain all Clear Rewards" and "Obtain the ☆45 Reward."

## __IMPORTANT__
- Once the event ends, Fierce Battle Area (Limited) rewards will no longer be available (and will not be sent to your Mail). Please remember to claim them within the event period.

1002734.article_name: [UPDATED] [TITLE REVISED] REGARDING PROGRESSION ISSUES ON CERTAIN DEVICES
article_raws: Updated 2026-07-16T03:00:00Z⤷In addition to the previously reported issue concerning the Main Story, we have confirmed that players on certain devices may experience progression issues or unexpected game closures due to high memory usage across other content.⤷As a corrective measure, multiple optimizations to reduce memory usage will be implemented incrementally.⤷We will update this announcement with details regarding the progress of the fix and compensation.⤷⤷We sincerely apologize to players experiencing this issue.⤷

*Since this issue has been found to affect content beyond the Main Story, the title of this announcement has been revised.⤷Updated 2026-07-13T08:00:00Z⤷Following our investigation, we have determined that the cause of this issue to be high memory usage on certain devices during some battles in Main Story Chapter 13 and the New Chapter Event.⤷With today's data update, we have implemented a measure to reduce memory usage for these battles. However, it is possible that the issue may persist on certain devices.⤷We sincerely apologize to players experiencing this issue and ask for your continued patience as work to resolve the issue continues.⤷Thank you for playing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.⤷

We have confirmed an issue where players on certain devices may be unable to progress in Main Story Chapter 13.⤷⤷We are currently working to fix this issue.⤷We will update this announcement once the fix is complete.⤷We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.⤷
article_item:
Updated <t:1784170800>
In addition to the previously reported issue concerning the Main Story, we have confirmed that players on certain devices may experience progression issues or unexpected game closures due to high memory usage across other content.
As a corrective measure, multiple optimizations to reduce memory usage will be implemented incrementally.
We will update this announcement with details regarding the progress of the fix and compensation.

We sincerely apologize to players experiencing this issue.

*Since this issue has been found to affect content beyond the Main Story, the title of this announcement has been revised.*
Updated <t:1783929600>
Following our investigation, we have determined that the cause of this issue to be high memory usage on certain devices during some battles in Main Story Chapter 13 and the New Chapter Event.
With today's data update, we have implemented a measure to reduce memory usage for these battles. However, it is possible that the issue may persist on certain devices.
We sincerely apologize to players experiencing this issue and ask for your continued patience as work to resolve the issue continues.
Thank you for playing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.

We have confirmed an issue where players on certain devices may be unable to progress in Main Story Chapter 13.

We are currently working to fix this issue.
We will update this announcement once the fix is complete.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.

The new Ad Watch Gacha feature has been added, allowing players to perform free pulls daily by watching ads.

article_raws: ⤷Overview⤷Thank you for playing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.⤷To protect your game data, we ask that you link your account.⤷⤷

Account Linking⤷By linking your account, you can easily restore and transfer your game data even if you accidentally delete the app.⤷Additionally, if your current device malfunctions or if you wish to change devices, you can transfer your player data to the new device.⤷⤷

How to Link Your Account⤷You can link your account to your Apple Account or Google Account.⤷Steps to Link Account:⤷1. Select the global menu from the top right of the Home screen.⤷2. From the Menu (≡) on the top left of the screen, select Account Linking.⤷*Account Linking is not possible via "Data Transfer" on the title screen.⤷
3. On the Confirm Link screen, you can choose to "Sign in with Apple" or "Sign in with Google."⤷4. Sign in with your selected account.⤷⤷
[ATTACHMENT]

After signing in, the message "Account linking complete" will appear upon successful linking.⤷*Please keep your linked account information secure and avoid sharing it with others.⤷*After account linking is complete, a confirmation email will be automatically sent to the email address associated with the linked account.⤷⤷

FAQ: Regarding Account Linking⤷Q1: How do I restore my data or transfer my account?{;;nl;;}A1: Access Title Menu (≡) on the title screen, select Data Transfer and follow the on-screen instructions.⤷⤷Q2: After transferring account, will I be able to pick up my game progress from when I linked my account?{;;nl;;}A2: You can proceed with the game from when you were last online. For example, if you link your account when a mission is ongoing and transfer your account after clearing the mission, the game will proceed from the time when the mission is cleared.⤷

⤷Q3: After transferring my account to a different device, can I still play on the original device?{;;nl;;}A3: Yes, you can play on both devices. However, you cannot log in to the same account on both devices simultaneously. If a new login is detected on a device, you will be returned to the title screen on the previous device.⤷⤷Q4: Will my linked account be unlinked if I delete my player data?{;;nl;;}A4: No, deleting your player data will not unlink your account. To unlink an account, go to Menu (≡) > Account Linking.⤷
⤷Q5: I wish to change my linked account.{;;nl;;}A5: To do so, first unlink your current account via Menu (≡) > Account Linking. You will then be able to link a new account.⤷

To protect your game data, we ask that you link your account.

## __ACCOUNT LINKING__
By linking your account, you can easily restore and transfer your game data even if you accidentally delete the app.
Additionally, if your current device malfunctions or if you wish to change devices, you can transfer your player data to the new device.

## __HOW TO LINK YOUR ACCOUNT__
You can link your account to your Apple Account or Google Account.
Steps to Link Account:
1. Select the global menu from the top right of the Home screen.
2. From the Menu (≡) on the top left of the screen, select Account Linking.
*Account Linking is not possible via "Data Transfer" on the title screen.*

3. On the Confirm Link screen, you can choose to "Sign in with Apple" or "Sign in with Google."
4. Sign in with your selected account.

https://asset.kj8-thegame.com/info/production/content/1000030/24c168d8edfd5660c027eb7977e576f9.png?Expires=1788546638&Signature=c5bo7fApGHZ0w0z~~fTonHXa0tLav2-B-0TIcYheOXYQG2uHud7pklPHAtl7K7mMxApgWBHzeRx~Ye3KRSd1CAd8uvMs3~WFq1MgxvKeLbKVSAehmXYdPwfvcHS5L-zUjg7vcQ-bMun6IYGOBN39NYXJGyGseoXb7k5x9UrPAebbJysPwptyH6EBEmI78bBHRfZjuA7TtrekxDsIrBileENBk4drgViEkFw9cu7FLKy--xGHlffcFFJgQs5-bFG~QvtFhwnx-g677g8riDoZsJCCfS5c9fB9psjcbjWisiULHwpTxKZNc~L61z0AW2n8~B~t5zOhsOYjWi48wmT-vA__&Key-Pair-Id=K22LOBLWI3HWJQ

After signing in, the message "Account linking complete" will appear upon successful linking.
*Please keep your linked account information secure and avoid sharing it with others.*
*After account linking is complete, a confirmation email will be automatically sent to the email address associated with the linked account.*

## __FAQ: REGARDING ACCOUNT LINKING__
Q1: How do I restore my data or transfer my account?
A1: Access Title Menu (≡) on the title screen, select Data Transfer and follow the on-screen instructions.

Q2: After transferring account, will I be able to pick up my game progress from when I linked my account?
A2: You can proceed with the game from when you were last online. For example, if you link your account when a mission is ongoing and transfer your account after clearing the mission, the game will proceed from the time when the mission is cleared.

Q3: After transferring my account to a different device, can I still play on the original device?
A3: Yes, you can play on both devices. However, you cannot log in to the same account on both devices simultaneously. If a new login is detected on a device, you will be returned to the title screen on the previous device.

Q4: Will my linked account be unlinked if I delete my player data?
A4: No, deleting your player data will not unlink your account. To unlink an account, go to Menu (≡) > Account Linking.

Q5: I wish to change my linked account.
A5: To do so, first unlink your current account via Menu (≡) > Account Linking. You will then be able to link a new account.
